title: Classical dynamics from QFT via Stratonovich-Weyl correspondence
summary: We develop a formalism for extracting relativistic classical dynamics from the S-matrix, in which massive bodies are described on phase space while massless radiation is kept in the Fock space. Our formalism relies on the Stratonovich-Weyl (SW) correspondence between the operator and phase-space formulations of quantum mechanics, as implemented covariantly by the SW quantizer. For localized incoming states, classical observables are given by SW symbols of the appropriate operators evaluated on incoming asymptotic trajectories.
